title: Public Award Prospecting
one_line: Find companies that just won a government contract or public grant and reach them while the money is new.
description: Find companies that just won a government contract or public grant and reach them while the money is new. Use when someone wants to target contract winners, grant recipients, or public sector suppliers.
paragraph: A public award is a funding event with a public record, a date, and an amount, and it is far less contested than a venture round. This skill reads the award registers, filters to awards large enough to change behavior, resolves the recipient to a domain, and builds outreach timed to the award date.

requirements.cost: A free Apify account works. Each run bills your own Apify account at the actor's Store price: public-award-monitor 0.005 USD per award winner returned.
Free. It starts the Mamba Labs MCP server with `npx`.

requirements_summary: Needs an Apify token (usage billed to your Apify account); Node.js 18+.
